# Expanding credit opportunities with greater confidence


How a Regional European Bank shored-up its credit analysis and expanded into new markets with the help of Moody's OneView


October 12, 2026


## Executive summary


A mid-sized, independent European bank wanted to expand lending to unrated companies without compromising the disciplined risk management, stability , and advisory quality that define its strategy. Moody's OneView helped the bank replace fragmented research workflows with broader private-company coverage, consistent credit assessment, faster analysis, and proactive monitoring, giving analyts a more scalable foundation for confident growth.
